items.q: What is Payonix?
items.a: Payonix is a digital wallet and payment platform operated by Baku Pay LLC. The app lets you combine your bank cards in one place, pay via QR code, send money using just a phone number, and use financial services such as Instant Loan and salary advance. The company operates under license EPT-016 issued by the Central Bank of the Republic of Azerbaijan on 15.01.2025.

items.q: Is Payonix secure?
items.a: Yes. Payonix operates under a Central Bank license and safeguards user funds as required by law. All data travels over encrypted channels, and strong customer authentication (PIN, fingerprint, face recognition) protects account access and payments. Identity verification is performed via SİMA, and no biometric data is stored on the company's servers.

items.q: Are there any fees for using Payonix?
items.a: Downloading the app and opening an account is free, and most everyday operations carry no extra charge. Some services (for example certain transfers or paper statements) may carry a service fee — in those cases the exact amount is clearly displayed on screen before you confirm the operation. Nothing is charged until you confirm.

items.q: How can I learn the terms of the Instant Loan?
items.a: The exact terms of your Instant Loan — amount, term, interest rate and monthly payment — are shown in full inside the Payonix app before you sign the agreement. The Instant Loan page on this site explains the requirements, the step-by-step process, and shows a sample calculation. Nothing is hidden: you see every figure before you commit.

items.q: How do I contact customer support?
items.a: Call our hotline at *2021, write to info@payonix.com, or use the contact form on this site. Our office is at Malibo Residence, Shamil Azizbayov str. 217, Baku. Complaints are reviewed within 10 business days as required by law, and you are informed of the outcome.

about.intro: Payonix is an Azerbaijani fintech platform built to simplify everyday payments. The platform is operated by Baku Pay Limited Liability Company.
story: Baku Pay LLC was registered in December 2017 and has been working on the development of digital payments in Azerbaijan ever since. Our team's goal was simple: to bring people's everyday financial operations — payments, transfers, expense control — together in one app, quickly and securely.

Today the Payonix app serves more than 500,000 users. Our customers combine their bank cards in a single view, pay by QR code in seconds, send money using just a phone number, and use financial tools such as Instant Loan and salary advance.

In January 2025, Baku Pay LLC received license No. EPT-016 from the Central Bank of the Republic of Azerbaijan and continues to operate as a fully regulated payment organization. For our users this is the most important guarantee: your funds are safeguarded in line with legal requirements, and your transactions run on supervised infrastructure.

We develop the product based on user feedback. Every new feature — whether spending analytics or the discount program — is born from a real need. The Payonix team is based in Baku, and customer support is provided in the local language by specialists who understand the local market.
about.mission: To make financial services simple, transparent and accessible for everyone in Azerbaijan — no queues, no paperwork, no waiting.

faqPage.intro: We've collected answers to the most common questions about Payonix. Can't find what you're looking for? Call *2021 or write to us via the contact form.

items.q: What is Payonix and who operates it?
items.a: Payonix is a digital wallet and payment platform. It is operated by Baku Pay LLC, registered on 07.12.2017 and operating under license No. EPT-016 dated 15.01.2025, issued by the Central Bank of the Republic of Azerbaijan.

items.q: Which devices does the app work on?
items.a: Payonix is available for iOS (App Store) and Android (Google Play). You can reach our official store pages via the buttons at the bottom of this site.

items.q: Does opening an account cost anything?
items.a: No. Downloading the app, registering and opening a payment account is completely free.

items.q: How are my funds protected?
items.a: As required by law, Baku Pay LLC safeguards user funds by holding them in accounts opened with banks operating in Azerbaijan or by other permitted methods. All transactions run over encrypted channels.

items.q: How is identity verification performed?
items.a: Identity verification is carried out via SİMA (operated by AzInTelecom LLC). Face data is used solely for identification — Payonix does not collect or store biometric data on its own servers.

items.q: What should I do if my phone is lost or stolen?
items.a: Call *2021 immediately or notify us via the contact channels published on our official social media pages so we can temporarily block access to your account. Restoring your account on a new device requires identity verification.

items.q: What if I spot an unauthorized transaction?
items.a: Notify us no later than 6 months after the transaction if you discover an unauthorized or incorrectly executed payment. If the investigation confirms your claim, the amount is refunded in the manner prescribed by law.

items.q: Which operations carry a service fee?
items.a: Many everyday operations are free. Where a fee applies (for example certain transfers or paper statements), the amount is displayed on screen before you confirm — by confirming, you accept the fee.

items.q: What are the limits for non-verified accounts?
items.a: By law, users who have not completed identity verification have a monthly limit of 300 AZN (or equivalent) on transaction volume and stored balance, and such accounts can only be used for domestic payments. Full verification removes these limits.

items.q: Is currency exchange available?
items.a: Yes, the app provides a currency exchange service. The applicable rate is shown on screen before the operation.

items.q: Can I see the loan terms before signing?
items.a: Yes. All terms — amount, term, interest rate and monthly payment — are shown in full in the app before you confirm the agreement. Figures on this website are samples only.

items.q: Who can apply for an Instant Loan?
items.a: Anyone aged 18 or older with a valid ID card who has completed identity verification via SİMA. Every application is assessed individually.

items.q: What's the difference between Instant Advance and a loan?
items.a: Instant Advance is early access to part of the salary you've already earned: no interest is charged, only a flat service fee, and the amount is repaid automatically on payday. A loan is formalized for a chosen term with monthly payments.

items.q: What happens if I'm late on a loan payment?
items.a: In case of delay, measures set out in your agreement may apply, and it may affect your credit history. If you foresee difficulty paying, contact *2021 before the due date — we'll look for a solution together.

items.q: How do I close my account?
items.a: Under the agreement, you may terminate it with 30 days' notice, provided all obligations are fulfilled. Contact in-app support or call *2021; any remaining balance is returned to you as prescribed by law.

items.q: How long does a complaint review take?
items.a: Complaints are reviewed within 10 business days of receipt, and you are informed of the outcome. This does not limit your right to go to court.

items.q: Which support channels are available?
items.a: Hotline *2021, email info@payonix.com, the contact form on this site, and in-app support. Our address: Malibo Residence, Shamil Azizbayov str. 217, Baku.
